profile.headline: Full Stack Software / AI Engineer | React | NextJS | Adobe Commerce Certified | Laravel | AI Agentic Development
profile.summary:
I bring over 10 years of experience in full-stack development. Over the last 2–3 years, I’ve been upgrading my expertise by specializing in modern technologies, including Python, FastAPI, React, and TypeScript. I want to leverage this blend of deep frontend fundamentals and cutting-edge skills to help clients and businesses build high-performing, scalable web applications. My focus is not only on improving site performance and creating seamless user experiences, but also on applying best practices in SEO to make businesses more discoverable and competitive.

Beyond performance and visibility, I am passionate about accessibility. I want to help businesses connect with users they may have never considered, including those with disabilities, by building inclusive digital experiences. This not only expands their reach and strengthens customer relationships but also protects them from accessibility-related lawsuits. My goal is to align technical excellence with business growth, ensuring every web application I contribute to delivers long-term value, inclusivity, and impact.

My expertise spans across full-stack development, with a strong focus on:

Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, LESS

E-commerce platforms: Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, WordPress

Programming Languages (Backend): Laravel, Python, FastAPI

Cloud platforms: PostgreSQL, Neon, AWS

Database: MySQL, MongoDB/MongoDB Atlas

Tools: Git, Node.js, Postman, Vite, Vercel, REST APIs

positions.title: Web Consultant
positions.description:
Assists with development efforts, tech stack selection, engineering, and the overall scope for this SaaS in conjunction with the Chief Product Officer.

Helped develop the CRM system based on Laravel while also implementing bank-level security.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Applied expertise in Adobe Commerce to extend, rebrand, and provide ongoing support for US and international projects utilizing HTML5, PHP, LESS, and JS.

Built custom JS components to refactor and clean up bad practice JS code.

Ensured and optimized site responsiveness across different devices using liquid templating and CSS3 best practices.

Implemented new Shopify liquid templates and layouts to meet the client’s requirements. 

Configured Shopify apps and extensions to enhance site functionality and performance.

Utilized Google Optimizer to A/B test elements and features for conversion improvement.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · LESS (Stylesheet Language) · JavaScript · Shopify · Adobe Commerce

positions.title: Senior Magento Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Built custom component enhancements and addressed complex defects for Magento 2 templates using Storybook and React.

Developed Magento 2 Theme components utilizing PHP, HTML, LESS and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · SASS · GitHub · Magento 2 · React.js

positions.title: Mid-Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Mentor and help other developers when needed.
- Assist with architecture of client-side solutions.
- Used a combination of languages & frameworks (LESS, XML,JavaScript) to deliver layouts and functional requirements on the Magento 2 platform.
- Help ensure we continuously deliver a consistent experiences across all browsers, platforms and devices.
- Provide website maintenance and enhancements.
- Help write functional requirement documents and specifications
- Assist back-end developers in coding and troubleshooting
- Follow best practices for all languages, performance optimization and search engine optimization.

- Initialized and implemented a devdocs documentation website for processes and tutorials
- Debugged and problem solved various aspects of client websites & supported Project Managers.

projects.title: Financial Dashboard
projects.description:
Developed a full-stack, React-based financial dashboard. 

Featured components include a dashboard page with the latest invoices, revenues, customers, etc. An invoice page that includes a scalable search with real-time results. Created and inserted data into PostgreSQL via SQL scripts. Utilized UI streaming and Suspense to optimize UX experience, site performance, and handle API data load times.

projects.title: Game Hub Web App
projects.description: This app is built with React 18 and Chakra UI. I am currently working on adding filters for the genres display on the left as well as two dropdown filters and a search in place of the Navbar.
